What We Treat

Our Services & Pricing

Comprehensive dental care under one roof — from routine check-ups to advanced cosmetic and surgical procedures, with transparent pricing.

🔍

Check-ups & Diagnosis

From ₹300

Clinical examination and diagnosis of oral diseases, assessment of underlying medical conditions and evaluation of lifestyle diseases in the context of dental pathologies.

🦷

Teeth Cleaning

From ₹1,500

Oral prophylaxis/scaling that eliminates tartar on tooth surfaces and below the gums for a healthy oral condition.

🔧

Fillings & Sealants

From ₹1,500

Filling of teeth in anatomical variation cases to prevent the initiation of decaying process and protect tooth structure.

✨

Cosmetic Procedures

From ₹1,500

Composite resin-based restoration of decayed/damaged teeth for outstanding esthetic outcomes including smile designing.

👑

Veneers & Crowns

From ₹5,000

Prosthesis used to conceal developmental disorders of teeth for esthetic outcomes and to protect root canal treated teeth.

🏥

Root Canals

From ₹4,000

Root canal treatments for tooth damage beyond repair by fillings — performed with modern rotary endodontics for comfort.

🦴

Dental Implants

From ₹20,000

Endosteal and cortical implants based on clinical bone condition for both functional and esthetic outcomes — the gold standard for missing teeth.

🦷

Dentures & Bridges

From ₹40,000

Complete dentures, removable and implant-supported options for patients with missing teeth and compatible clinical conditions.

⚡

Extractions

From ₹1,500

Damaged and irreparable teeth removed with strict sterilisation and surgical safety protocols to prevent infections.

🔬

Laser Dentistry

From ₹10,000

Laser-assisted surgical procedures facilitate bloodless treatment sites and reduced healing time for superior outcomes.

👶

Paediatrics

From ₹1,000

Specialist paediatric dental procedures involving comforting children for surgical and restorative treatments in a gentle setting.

📡

Digital X-Ray

From ₹200

Digital dental imaging for effective diagnosis and treatment planning, minimising radiation exposure with instant visualisation.
